# CoreForge — Conveyor Filters

> CoreForge is a web app to design, organise and share Rust industrial conveyor
> filter presets. Users build presets in the browser (categories →
> subcategories → filters → up to 30 items with Max / Buffer / Min per slot) and
> copy/paste the exact JSON the game expects.

Most of the app requires a user account; the pages below are the public surface.

## Pages

- [Home](https://coreforge-conveyor-filters.negri.es/): landing page and sign-in entry point.
- [Legal](https://coreforge-conveyor-filters.negri.es/legal): terms, privacy and licensing information.

## Access

- [Sign in](https://coreforge-conveyor-filters.negri.es/login): existing accounts.
- [Create an account](https://coreforge-conveyor-filters.negri.es/register): new users.

## Notes

- Interactive filter management, categories and the game-JSON import/export tools
  live behind authentication and are not available to anonymous agents.
- There is no public API or MCP server. The JSON interchange format is produced
  and consumed inside the authenticated app.
